scope: E-010 registry, fixture, runner, policy, artifact and corpus harness evidence

T-E010-REGISTRY-001.selector: formal Source-ID registry completeness and negative fixtures
assertions: all 736 unique Accepted and executable contract IDs have one explicit status
a removed or duplicate coverage entry fails with a stable registry rule ID
COVERED without a per-source assertion fails
UNIT evidence cannot satisfy a mandatory PostgreSQL DB layer
generated registry drift fails until the versioned registry is regenerated

T-E010-HARNESS-001.selector: synthetic fixture, deterministic source and artifact known-fail tests
assertions: golden provenance must name an Accepted contract rather than current implementation output
fixture identities, time and random sources are synthetic and replayable
property failures require a replay seed and fixture version

T-E010-ARTIFACT-001.selector: artifact content policy positive and negative fixtures
assertions: synthetic metadata passes the content policy
forbidden identity, credential, Prompt and raw-content keys or values fail with stable codes

T-E010-POLICY-001.selector: retry, sticky flaky and quarantine policy tests
assertions: the real Playwright known-fail runner exits non-zero when retry 1 passes after retry 0 fails
a retry pass after an initial failure remains FLAKY_FAIL in the shared classifier and reporter
critical source IDs cannot be quarantined

T-E010-POLICY-002.selector: test source skip/focus and production helper import known-fail fixtures
assertions: test.only, test.skip and test.todo fail the source policy Gate
production source imports of tests or testing helper exports fail the source policy Gate

T-E010-CORPUS-001.selector: 269-case Accepted AI corpus integrity and fingerprint test
assertions: all 269 case IDs are unique and the canonical manifest fingerprint matches
a case mutation invalidates the corpus without making a model call

T-E010-HTTP-CONTRACT-001.selector: closed OpenAPI error envelope and forbidden client field contract Gate
assertions: the error envelope and nested error object reject unknown fields
public response contracts cannot expose stack, provider, model, Prompt or restricted fields

T-E010-HTTP-E2E-001.selector: real Nest application through Playwright APIRequestContext
assertions: the real Nest readiness endpoint returns the closed JSON health contract over a TCP listener
unknown request fields produce the stable validation envelope and preserve a safe request ID
HTTP errors contain no framework, stack, SQL, provider, model, Prompt or restricted details

T-E010-HTTP-E2E-002.selector: public and Admin audience separation over real Nest HTTP
assertions: an Admin bearer cannot enter the public launch route
a public bearer cannot enter the Admin operations route
